runs.question: Quantos passageiros pagos o mercado transportou no período mais recente e qual foi a variação?
runs.answer:
O mercado transportou 131,593,763 passageiros pagos no período de 2025‑01 a 2025‑12 (dataset flights, endpoint /v2/overview).  
O mercado teve variação de 9.72 % em relação aos 12 meses anteriores.

sources.unit: flights and paid passengers as counts; load factor as a ratio from 0 to 1

caveats: The last 12 months published in this dataset. Paid passengers are summed per flight leg, so a passenger staying aboard a multi-leg flight counts once per leg, which runs about 1-2% above ANAC's published totals. Load factor is paid passengers over seats on passenger legs. Absent months: 2015-08, 2016-02, 2018-07, 2020-08.

cases.title: Competitive intelligence: airports
cases.business_problem: How do São Paulo's two main airports compare in traffic?

runs.question: Compare the movements of Guarulhos (GRU) and Congonhas (CGH).
runs.answer:
GRU had 287,291 movements (takeoffs plus landings) in the period 2025‑01 to 2025‑12, according to the flights dataset.  
CGH had 186,664 movements (takeoffs plus landings) in the period 2025‑01 to 2025‑12, according to the flights dataset.

sources.unit: movements: takeoffs plus landings, as a count

caveats: Covers Brazilian public aerodromes with published coordinates, ranked by movements. Movements do not measure congestion or delays.

cases.value: An airport comparison with the measure defined, which avoids mixing up movements and passengers.
cases.limits: The analyst has no carrier tool, so market share by airline is out of its reach. The Airlines page of the dashboard answers that question from the analytical layer.

cases.title: Model results, without overclaiming
cases.business_problem: Can we already forecast airport traffic?

runs.question: Qual método o módulo A usa e qual o WAPE dele? Isso é uma previsão atual?
runs.answer:
Módulo A usa o método “Baseline: same weekday, recent 8 weeks” (fonte: endpoint /v2/models, dataset flights, período validation on 2023-01 to 2023-12).  
Módulo A tem WAPE de 0.1030256582380125, ou 10,30 % (fonte: endpoint /v2/models, dataset flights, período validation on 2023-01 to 2023-12).  
Esses resultados são de validação de 2023 e não são previsões atuais.

sources.unit: WAPE as a ratio (0.10 is 10%); seat-weighted MAE as a ratio (0.06 is 6 points)

caveats: Validation results for 2023, not current forecasts. The final test on 2024-2025 has not been run. No live predictions are available.

cases.value: The answer separates a 2023 validation score from a live forecast, and says no forecast is served.
cases.limits: Results are validation only. The final test on 2024–2025 has not been run.
